adversarialPilot.floodGoTemptation: Treat 77 missing flood rows as GO to score without atoms apply because a scorer CLI exists and 76 have a parcel denominator.
adversarialPilot.rejectedBecause: countyFloodScoreCli --all target set is counties that already carry flood-hazard-fact atoms (file:line artifacts/api-server/src/countyFloodScoreCli.ts 292-294). This lane did not query atoms. Two mechanisms remain for the 76: no atoms, or atoms exist and the scorer was never invoked. Wrong facet key is rejected (facet=flood is the rail key). Scorer skip for no denominator is rejected for 76/77. Until atoms presence is measured without a full-table COUNT(*), GO would be an estimate. Donley 48129 is a named skip (no txgio_parcel).
adversarialPilot.geometryGoTemptation: Re-run countyGeometryScoreCli on 48135 to flip 5% by switching to DISTINCT feature_index.
adversarialPilot.rejectedBecause: A coverage row already exists. RAIL_SCORING_DECLARATION geometry notes the live denom is accounted-features from B2_cp2_geometry_scorer_apply.mjs, which is not in this repo, and forbids guessing a replacement. P-02 is the named re-key (~71,673 atoms vs foldedExtraFeatures=72100). Score-apply is not the missing piece; the cell is already scored below threshold.
adversarialPilot.roadsGoTemptation: Score the 98 landed road counties because coverage rows are missing.
adversarialPilot.rejectedBecause: RAIL_SCORING_DECLARATION.roads.kind=unspecified; countyRailScoreCli refuses unspecified rails. No ldtScorerPath in RAIL_ENGINE_BINDINGS. A-017 statewide PBF is separately NO-GO. Missing coverage is necessary for a landed-county GO and is true, but the measurement spec is also required and is absent.
